spans.s: + आत्मन् जित- + आत्मन्, adj. one who has subdued his mind, who restrains himself, Pañc. 131, 19.
+ इन्द्रिय जित- + इन्द्रिय, adj. one who has subdued his senses,
-जि + त्, latter part of comp. words, Victorious, conquering, e. g. कैटभ-, m. A name of Viṣṇu (slayer of the demon Kaiṭabha), Śiś. 9, 30. युद्ध-, adj. Victorious in battle,
. स्वर्-, The name of a kind of sacrifice,
+ श्रम जित- + श्रम, adj. not suffering from fatigue, Hit. iii. d. 87.
